messages:
claire: FYI — Goldenrod Health wants to POC a new variant (goldenrod-16b-slim) for triage chat + clinical embeddings. They asked whether we can onboard and approximate timeline + costs for 120M gen tokens and 8M embed tokens/mo.

ben: goldenrod-16b-slim is not in catalog yet. We can onboard but need model weights, tokenizer, license, and ~1k representative prompts. Also ask for max_context and expected qps.

li: From infra side: slim -> likely quantized. We'll test q4_k and q5_k, run perf on A100 and H100. If they need >16k context, we need to validate KV cache and might swap to larger GPU.

security: PHI involved? If yes, recommend Dedicated or Private with BAA. Need DPO contact, data flow diagram, and note on whether embeddings will store PHI. We require encrypted indices for PHI.

ops-bot: upload-check: waiting for artifact verification.

ben: Suggested steps: 1) get artifacts + tokenizer + 1k prompts; 2) tokenizer roundtrip + edge cases; 3) smoke forward pass; 4) quantization candidates + perf sweep; 5) quality evals on clinical extraction; 6) recommend deployment type (hosted vs dedicated/private); 7) canary + SLA.

claire: Customer asks whether validation can be done in 5 business days after artifacts. Also asked for a ballpark cost.

li: Perf + tokenizer sanity — 3 business days if clean. Full safety and extraction eval — +2 days. If >16k context tuning required, add +3 days. Realistic 7-8 business days.

security: Legal timeline for BAA/private addendum is ~2-3 weeks, possible blocker.

ben: Quick tokenizer check to give them:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print(sum(len(i) for i in ids))"
```
Smoke forward pass:
```
python -c "import torch; from loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,512)); print(m(x).shape)"
```

claire: I'll request artifacts, 1k prompts, peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response so billing can draft a quote.

ops-bot: artifact verified, checksum OK.
